notes: Round 1 (disassembly). Server: python3 run.py serve via analysis/tools/rpcd.py bridge; helpers analysis/tools/nes.py. press(b,hold,after) = hold button b for `hold` frames then release for `after` frames (emulator.input buttons list + emulator.step unit=frame, max_operations 1e8). Tracing (trace.configure enabled, capacity 0, kinds Instruction/ControlFlow/BankSwitch) runs at ~3 frames/s, so it was enabled only around transitions/menus. Named snapshots are session-local; analysis/snapshots/title.json is an exported snapshot of the title screen (same-build only). Redirect r1-a7 helper: /tmp scratch step.py equivalent = analysis/tools/nes.py press(b,hold,after)/run(n)/write(addr,bytes); bridge socket path via env ROMATLAS_SCRATCH. Base snapshot boot1340 = emulator.start; run(140) untraced; run(1200) traced (frame 1340, title screen).
